summary: Computes closest-approach proximity distances from this vehicle to two target entities by projecting position+direction lines. Target1 is resolved through the this+0x110 pointer, target2 through the this+0x114 pointer; own data comes from the this+0x10C block plus direct fields. Parallel (non-intersecting) directions store a sentinel, self references store 0, otherwise the smaller of the two line distances is stored as a float into this+0xB0 (target1) and this+0xB4 (target2).

local_names.v16/v6: target1 line distances (intersection to target1 vs to self)
local_names.v17/v14: target2 line distances (intersection to target2 vs to self)

operations.description: Entry guards: the own data-block pointer this+0x10C must be non-null, the target1 pointer this+0x110 must be non-null, and the target1 object's internal pointer (field +0x110 of the target1 object) must be non-null.

Load target1 position (X at *(this+0x110)+0x94, Y at +0x9C), own position (this+0x94, this+0x9C), own direction (this+0xA4, negated Y at this+0xAC) and target1 direction (*(this+0x110)+0xA4/+0xAC); form the cross product v4 = own.dirX * target1.dirY - own.dirY * target1.dirX.

Parallel-direction branch for target1: when the cross product v4 lies within +/-0.00001 the directions are parallel; write 0 to this+0xB0 when the target is self, otherwise write the large sentinel 1232348144, and return.

Line-intersection projection for target1: solve the intersection parameter from the position deltas and the direction ratio (target1.dirX / -target1.dirY) using target1 position (*(this+0x110)+0x94/+0x9C), target1 direction (*(this+0x110)+0xA4/+0xAC) and own position/direction (this+0x94/+0x9C/+0xA4/+0xAC); compute the two distances v16 (intersection to target1 position) and v6 (intersection to own position).
Store target1 proximity to this+0xB0: 0 when the target is self (this+0x110 == this), otherwise the smaller of the two distances v16 and v6 as a float.
Second-target guard: the target2 pointer this+0x114 must be non-null.

Load the own data-block position/direction from the this+0x10C object (fields +0x94/+0x9C/+0xA4/+0xAC) and the target2 position (fields *(this+0x114)+0x0/+0x8); form the cross product v11 = data.dirX * this+0xAC - data.dirY * this+0xA4 against the own direction fields.

Parallel-direction branch for target2: when the cross product v11 lies within +/-0.00001, write the FLT_MAX-like large float sentinel to this+0xB4 when the target is not self and return; when the target is self fall through to the zero store.

Line-intersection projection for target2: use the target2 position delta (fields *(this+0x114)+0x0/+0x8), the own data-block position/direction (fields *(this+0x10C)+0x94/+0x9C/+0xA4/+0xAC) and the own position fields (this+0x94/+0x9C); compute the distances v17 (intersection to target2 position) and v14 (intersection to the own data position).
Store target2 proximity to this+0xB4: 0 when the target is self (this+0x114 == this), otherwise the smaller of the two distances v17 and v14 as a float.
